description: Five stars filling gold left-to-right, one at a time with a small settle bounce, plus a rating/review-count label. Use for a review/rating/'rate this' beat (engine/components/AppNativeScenes.tsx).

The Instagram/TikTok double-tap heart burst: a heart scales up past 100% then settles, with a deterministic radial particle burst, plus a ticking like count. Use for a 'like'/'double-tap'/reaction beat (engine/components/AppNativeScenes.tsx).

A single comment card (avatar, name, text, like count) springing into place — the 'a real reply just landed' social-proof beat. Narrower fit than CTAEndPlate's comment-bait closer: this is showing an incoming comment, not asking the viewer to leave one (engine/components/AppNativeScenes.tsx).

A thermal-printer-style receipt (monospace, dashed separators, torn bottom edge) revealing line by line, right-aligned prices, ending on the total. Use for an order-summary/checkout-total/'here's the receipt' beat (engine/components/AppNativeScenes.tsx).

A structurally real QR code (ISO/IEC 18004 finder-pattern geometry) assembling module-by-module top-to-bottom, paid off with a scan-line sweep. Use for a 'scan this' / QR-code beat (engine/components/AppNativeScenes.tsx).
